topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: While sorting through the attic, I stumbled upon relics of the past tenants. Old suitcases, their contents yellowed with age, photographs in brittle frames, and a child’s bicycle, now rusted and silent. Rather than feeling overwhelmed, I found myself intrigued by the human traces left behind. Each item told a story of someone else’s life, now woven into the fabric of this house. I decided to set aside a corner for these remnants, preserving them for a moment before deciding their fate. For now, they rest, quiet and undisturbed, as I continue to settle into the home, layering my own memories atop theirs.
